_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant D — Strategy D 'DC Time Machine' (Steve Burnich, video JtGW1wNFNIY): a multi-day SPX double calendar that transforms into a risk-free iron condor. SCAFFOLD + DRY-RUN-LOCKED. The strategy class (bots/hydra/double_calendar_strategy.py:DoubleCalendarStrategy) refuses any non-dry_run construction; its entry/transformer/multi-day-settlement logic is stubbed (D idles, skips entries, opens NOTHING) pending the full build. brandon.enabled=false so D runs its own (HydraStrategy-derived) path, not the Brandon stack. alerts + google_sheets are OFF so D never pollutes the canonical record or pages the operator. Do NOT flip dry_run=false next to a live C until MUST-FIX #1/#2/#3 ship (scope STATE-004 + orphan sweep to per-variant conids; budget buying power) — see the module docstring.
_comment_credentials: IBKR OAuth credentials are loaded from systemd $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY on the VM, or env vars in dev. Not in this file.

strategy._comment_strategy_name: Selects DoubleCalendarStrategy via the registry (bots/hydra/registry.py). brandon.enabled=false below so the registry resolves strategy.name, not brandon.
strategy.name: double_calendar
strategy._comment_double_calendar: Strategy-D-specific knobs (consumed by DoubleCalendarStrategy.__init__). Mirrors the DC Time Machine spec: short legs 6-15 DTE, long legs +1-4 DTE, shorts ~30-40 delta, transform on a ~7.5% intraday profit, 20%-of-debit pre-transform hard stop, 5pt wings, close at EOD day-1 if not transformed. UNUSED while the entry logic is stubbed; wired here so the surface is ready for the build.
strategy._comment_contracts: 1c while D is a dry-run scaffold (start small; the source trades SPX 1-lot examples). Raise deliberately only after the entry logic is built and paper-verified.
strategy._comment_bp_calendar: ORDER-004 BP floor for a double calendar (defined risk = the net debit paid). Much smaller than the IC defined-risk floor. Read by DoubleCalendarStrategy._min_buying_power_per_unit.

brandon._comment: OFF on D — D is its own (HydraStrategy-derived) multi-day strategy, not the Brandon iron-condor stack. Disabling here makes the registry resolve strategy.name='double_calendar'.

google_sheets._comment: OFF on D (scaffold/dry-run) — D must not write to the canonical Sheets record.

alerts._comment: OFF on D (scaffold/dry-run) — avoids alert spam and operator paging. NOTE: CRITICAL/HIGH alerts still publish via the L-C2 severity bypass even when disabled; D's stubbed path emits none, but keep this in mind before enabling real-order D.

_comment_api_pacing: 2.5 (gentler than C's 2.0) because a real double-calendar would fetch TWO-expiration chains + intraday transform monitoring — extra load on the shared calypso-broker session. Harmless while stubbed; set conservatively for the build.
